name: Tooltip
summary: A short, transient hint shown on mouse hover or keyboard focus of its trigger (not on click or tap).
highlights: Shown on mouse hover or keyboard focus of its trigger (not on click or tap)
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-tooltip text="…"> — wraps a trigger and shows the shared black bubble (with an arrow) on mouse hover or keyboard focus (not on click/tap). Defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue; shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. This is the single shared tooltip the settings pattern's ? help glyph references. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Bubble
spec.value: black #1A1A1A (--aha-bg-dark; or brand #E70E68), white text, radius 6, padding 6 10, max-width 280 (--aha-tooltip-max-width) then wraps; narrows to fit a clipping panel narrower than that

spec.label: Arrow
spec.value: anchored to the trigger, matches the fill; `arrow=false` hides it

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: top (default) · bottom · left · right centred, PLUS 8 edge-aligned (top-start/-end, bottom-start/-end, left-start/-end, right-start/-end) — same side, aligned to the trigger edge with the arrow on the trigger's centre (a trigger smaller than twice radius + 5px shifts the bubble outward past its edge). Auto-placement: on show, and again on every scroll while it stays visible, the bubble is measured against its clipping panel (the nearest overflow ancestor, across shadow roots, cut down to the viewport); when the chosen side has no room it moves to the opposite side, then the roomier perpendicular side, then slides along that side to stay inside, the arrow kept on the trigger. `placement` stays the preference; the side used is reflected as `data-placement`

spec.label: Trigger
spec.value: mouse hover or keyboard focus (default; not on click/tap) · focus · click (toggle, Esc/click-away to close); `open` forces it visible

spec.label: Help
spec.value: `help` renders a built-in `?` trigger — a DS <aha-icon name="system-question"> at 16px, muted (--aha-icon-muted #8A8A8A) → --aha-icon-default #4A4A4A on hover/focus, focus ring 2px #E70E68 — the settings-label help glyph; focusable, so it shows on focus, not hover-only. Bakes `help` defaults: no author placement → bottom-start; no author arrow → arrow off (both still overridable)

spec.label: Canvas (size lg)
spec.value: the in-canvas tooltip for an icon-only presenter control: name 16px / 400 on a 24px line, one line (no wrap at 280px), padding 6 12, 36px tall, radius 6, no drop shadow, a 1px edge of white at 20% (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px) so it stays apart from a dark deck, carried round the arrow as one continuous outline; the default size is unchanged

spec.label: Shortcut chip
spec.value: size lg only: `shortcut` draws the key after the name, 8px from it, with 6px after the chip: 24 × 24 square, radius 4, key 14px / 400 on a 16% white wash; a longer key keeps the height and grows with 6px side padding; Mac or Windows glyphs follow the machine; Enter is the DS icon system-key-return; aria-hidden, because the trigger's aria-label carries the key ("Mute music (M)")

spec.label: a11y
spec.value: role=tooltip; the built-in help button takes aria-describedby (same shadow root); a slotted trigger gets the text as its accessible description from a visually hidden node in the tooltip's light DOM, whose id is appended to the trigger's aria-describedby (an id cannot cross into the shadow root; author ids are kept, only the tooltip's is removed); an aha-button forwards aria-describedby to its inner button by element reflection, other custom-element triggers do not; skipped when the trigger's aria-label or text already contains the text; shows on focus, Esc dismisses it, the bubble is hoverable, no leaked listeners

props.name: text
props.desc: The hint text shown in the bubble

props.name: placement
props.desc: Which side of the trigger the bubble + arrow sit on. The 4 cardinal values centre the bubble; the 8 edge-aligned values (…-start / …-end) align it to the trigger's start/end edge with the arrow on the trigger's centre (kept at least radius + 5px from the bubble corner) — the -end arrow mirrors the -start one (AntD naming). A preference, not a promise: when that side has no room inside the clipping panel or viewport, the bubble opens on the opposite side (then the roomier perpendicular side) and slides along it to stay inside; the side used is reflected as `data-placement`

props.name: color
props.desc: Bubble fill: black #1A1A1A or brand color-primary #E70E68

props.name: arrow
props.desc: Show the caret pointing at the trigger; arrow="false" hides it

props.name: trigger
props.desc: How it opens: hover+focus · focus only · click to toggle

props.name: open
props.desc: Force the bubble visible (demos/tests); otherwise the trigger opens it

props.name: size
props.desc: lg is the canvas tooltip: 16px / 400 name, one line, 6px / 12px padding (36px tall), no drop shadow, a 1px edge of white at 20%

props.name: shortcut
props.desc: size="lg" only. Display-only keyboard chip after the name, the same as aha-button's: "M", "Esc", "Enter", "Shift+Enter", "Mod+Enter" (Mod = ⌘ on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere); aria-hidden, so keep the key in the trigger's aria-label

props.name: help
props.desc: Render a built-in `?` help trigger — a focusable button carrying the DS <aha-icon name="system-question"> (16px, --aha-icon-muted → --aha-icon-default on hover/focus) — instead of requiring a slotted trigger. The settings-label help-glyph pattern; shows on focus as well as hover

whenToUse.when: a brief, non-essential hint — an icon-only button's name, a ? help elaboration
an icon-only presenter control on the slide canvas: the name plus its shortcut chip ("Mute music" + M); the button's aria-label keeps "Mute music (M)"
a must-see consequence that is hard to undo — put it inline, not in a tooltip
richer content or interactive controls — a tooltip is text only

opinion.note: Never hide essential information in a tooltip — it is unavailable on touch (a tap does not show it) and to keyboard users who don't focus the trigger. Keep it to one short plain-text sentence (see UXW-9 in the UX writing guideline); the trigger must be focusable.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 / AntD Tooltip matrix: `placement` now ships the FULL 12-placement set — the 4 cardinal sides (top/bottom/left/right, centred) PLUS the 8 edge-aligned ones (top-start, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-end, left-start, left-end, right-start, right-end — same side, aligned to the trigger's start/end edge with the arrow on the trigger's centre, -end the mirror of -start, AntD naming) — a `title` (our `text`), a `color` (default dark vs a brand fill), an `arrow` on/off, and `trigger` (hover/focus/click). All ship on the element. The measured DS V3 `tooltip|card` cell is a distinct rich 260px info CARD (white text, 16px padding, an icon) — a popover, not this simple text hint — and remains a separate future component. This `aha-tooltip` is the black hint bubble the settings skill's `?` help tooltip points to; spec derived from that convention + tokens (bg-dark, color-primary, text-inverse, radius-sm, 12/18). Motion is the shared .2s ease-out pop on a PERSISTENT node (class/attr toggle, never a subtree rebuild — the historic MOTION_DEBT trap is clean).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: placement top/bottom/left/right + arrow toggle + brand fill
auto-placement: never clipped by its overflow panel or the viewport, flips then slides, arrow stays on the trigger, placement attribute kept (tests/tooltip-clip.test.mjs)
shows on focus, role=tooltip, the slotted trigger's accessible description is the text (aria-describedby to a hidden light-DOM node), Esc dismisses, hoverable
size lg: 16px / 400 name, 36px bubble, no shadow, 1px white 20% edge; shortcut chip 24 × 24, radius 4, 14px / 400, aria-hidden
click trigger toggles + closes on Esc/click-away, no leaked listeners
help renders <aha-icon> ? at 16px, muted --aha-icon-muted (→ --aha-icon-default on hover/focus), focus ring 2px #E70E68, focusable, aria-describedby wired
help bakes defaults: no author placement → bottom-start, no author arrow → off (both overridable)

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The bubble probe uses `open` so the bubble is in layout and measurable; a second `data-probe-help` probe (a full-sentence hint) verifies the bubble fills toward its 280px cap (>=150px, not squeezed to the 16px trigger width, one word per line) and verifies the built-in `?` help trigger renders a 16px DS <aha-icon> in the muted icon colour, is focusable, and wires aria-describedby; the slotted trigger's aria-describedby resolves to a light-DOM node carrying the text.
